## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for a user.

## Validation

List relevant focused tests, native gates and actual CLI/plugin probes with results. Identify skipped checks, synthetic host adapters and remaining limitations.

## Review notes

- [ ] Changes are scoped; unrelated work and local evidence/state are excluded.
- [ ] Existing profile settings, ownership receipts and native IDs are preserved or their intended behavior is explained.
- [ ] Payload hashes were regenerated last if payload content changed.
- [ ] Temporary profiles/processes are cleaned up; diagnostics contain no secrets.
- [ ] Version, publication and manual workflow safeguards remain intact unless separately approved.

See CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md before submitting sensitive evidence.
